description: Senator Susan Collins is a strong advocate for Maine’s lobstermen and women, securing tens of millions of dollars in federal funding to support the industry and fighting against overly burdensome regulations. She secured a six-year pause on new NOAA regulations affecting the American Lobster Fishery, to provide more time for additional research and data collection […]
